annotations.text:
ABS CHALLENGE REPORT — second pass

Six new sections on /abs-challenges plus one card on the team hub, drawn at iPhone width. The 960 px reflow is on the Wide page.

This version is after four reviews — site consistency, glance, prose, and the charts against the dataviz rules. What changed is listed on the notes below each artboard.

The app's own vocabulary throughout: manila #F3ECD8, navy #1B2A3A, clay #B4453A, graphite #6B6558, the broadcast section rule, the slab, the square .rpt-chip. No new colour.

FIXED SINCE THE FIRST PASS

· The role panels were on a denominator exactly 2× the chart above them — batter + catcher + pitcher summed to twice the club rate while carrying the same label. They now share the club denominator and add up to the headline.
· The median rule on the baselines pointed at 5.11 under a label reading 5.90. Its position now derives from the value.
· Umpires said 1.3 for a spread of 2.27. Conditional said four tenths for 0.33.
· The team card led with the batter rate on both views.
· Clay against graphite fails the colourblind check (ΔE 4.8 protan) and they shared one series. Thin-evidence bars are hollow now, not grey.
· Every axis label was --graphite-soft at 9–10px: 3.1:1, under AA. Now --graphite at 11px.
· The pitcher panel drew nine identical 1.5px bars. It is a stat line.

SPOILER RULE — this board names games

Club, opponent, date, inning, the call and how far off the edge it was. No score, no winner, no run total, nothing a result can be read back out of.

Every name here is a link — player, club and game — which the first pass had as plain text.

THE DENOMINATOR

A raw count by inning misleads twice: not every game reaches the ninth, and a club with two failed challenges cannot call for one at all. Tap "Raw count" to see the difference the correction makes.

It needs a final inning per game, which the ledger does not store. Plan: two columns filled from the game feed's own linescore at sweep time, backfilled from one schedule call per week per level. No feed is refetched.

STILL OPEN — your call

1. CAPS. The page today ships its sentences SHOUTING (.hint carries no exemption). These artboards show natural-case prose, which needs a registered caps-exempt. Precedent exists — Game Notes took it for the same reason — but it changes this page's convention.

2. THE LEVEL CHIP. The page already has MLB / Triple-A. Every section here is hard-coded to MLB. Wiring it through is cheap and makes six sections into twelve.

3. MONO HERO FIGURES. The dataviz standard says a big standalone number should not be monospaced or tabular. The house scorebook voice says otherwise, and the shipped slabs already do it. Kept as-is deliberately.
